item.title: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold8 review – the smartphone to open the floodgates for new foldable users
item.summary: The Samsung Galaxy Z Fold8 is literally changing the shape of smartphones and has provided a more accessible gateway for customers to graduate to a foldable device. For eight years Samsung’s foldable devices have looked like regular smartphones and won a loyal band of customers who have stayed true to the form factor.
